_about: The Dwarven Mines of Khaz-Durum (levels 8-25), overrun: goblin raiders swarm from the Kobold Nest and help each other, cave spiders lurk, the earth elemental is an elite, the dwarves call their guard, and Skarg the goblin warlord holds the Hall of the Mountain King, calling his raiders and bringing down the roof.

helpers.shout: The goblin raider screeches, and the raiders come running!
The spider's web trembles, and more come!
The dwarven guard bellows: "Raiders in the mine!"

10050.name: skarg goblin warlord
10050.long_desc: Skarg the goblin warlord lounges on the Mountain King's throne, picking his teeth with a dwarven dagger.
10050.description: A big goblin in a dwarf king's stolen mail, far too long for him, with a crown jammed over one ear and a cleaver in his fist. He took the hall, and he means to keep it.

helpers.shout: The goblin raider screeches, and the raiders come running!

phases.message: Skarg leaps up on the throne: "Kill them, lads!"

abilities.name: War Screech
abilities.telegraph: Skarg screeches a war cry that echoes through the hall!

abilities.name: Bring It Down
abilities.telegraph: Skarg hammers at a pillar to bring down the roof!

patrols.why: a goblin raider runs from the nest to the hall

bosses.why: Skarg on the Mountain King's throne

mechanics.label: Falling Rock
mechanics.why: the roof comes down: step out

_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 6 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim
